playback: One continuous native event owned by the vehicle sound component, not repeated SoundEvent calls per frame

bank.loopSeam: NOT_AUDITIONED; stock recording may require supported loop-point authoring; do not extract or repackage
bank.volumeUnitsGate: Bank Volume is documented in dB. GEPTrackLevel is linear amplitude. Never connect idle linear 0 to a dB input as silence. Verify native live-input units; use native linear gain or correctly mapped dB plus a verified exact mute gate. -60 dB is attenuation, not mathematical silence.

GEPTrackVolumeDb.units: diagnostic dB conversion for a verified dB input only

position: one hull-centre native sound point near track height; avoid two phase-coherent centre loops
perspective: Use native vehicle interior/exterior and occlusion routing only after it is verified in the current sound component. No claimed cabin filter or hatch coupling yet.
duplicateControl: Retain existing single stock engine graph. Before audition, determine whether inherited APC wheel rolling layer overlaps the proposed track layer. Replace only that rolling branch/slot if required; retain impacts, skid and suspension. Never append a second engine graph.
resourceAndGraphGate: Integration owner must resolve exact stock GUID through supported Workbench APIs, author/save/compile original ACP with native Audio Editor, verify actual graph signal units and one event instance. This contract must not be renamed .acp or copied as a native graph.
fallback: Keep production addon byte-identical; optional QA signal probe adds no audio. GEP033 remains Blocked pending supported graph authoring and native qualification.
dynamicInputGate: Native volume and pitch input ports must have Update enabled and be proven changing on an already-running loop; connection alone does not establish live updates.
eventLifecycleGate: Custom GEP_TRACK_MOVEMENT_LP is not assumed to auto-start. Default-disabled QA lifecycle source issues at most one SoundComponent.SoundEventOffset after signal readiness, never retries/restarts per frame, and terminates its owned handle on destruction/deletion. It remains uncompiled/uninstantiated and needs actual handle/culling/dynamic-simulation qualification.
